records.question: 2014 年销售额最高的 5 个国家是哪些?

records.sql:
SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
GROUP BY c.country
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

records.tags: 多表/聚合/时间/枚举陷阱
records.question: 亚太市场按月的销售额趋势是怎样的?
records.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS ym, ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS sales
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN geography g ON g.country = c.country AND g.region = c.region
WHERE g.market = 'Asia Pacific'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym

records.question: 平均折扣最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 17 项中最高是 Phones(179),其次 Bookcases(130),最低 Envelopes(2),最高约为最低的 89.5 倍。按 avg_discount 计,最高是 Binders(0.34)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       COUNT(*) AS lines,
       ROUND(AVG(oi.discount), 4) AS avg_discount,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.discount * oi.sales) / NULLIF(SUM(oi.sales), 0), 4) AS sales_weighted_discount
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY avg_discount DESC

records.question: 2014 年每个季度的销售额分别是多少?
records.sql:
SELECT (CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       SUM(i.sales) AS sales,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders,
       COUNT(*) AS items
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2014'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter;

records.question: 利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最高的 3 个商品子类是哪些?
records.chart_reading: 5 项中最高是 Binders(7,435.09),其次 Paper(806.32),最低 Labels(21.86),最高约为最低的 340.1 倍。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Binders(19,751.19)。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(i.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(i.profit) / SUM(i.sales), 4) AS profit_margin
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE i.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin DESC
LIMIT 5

records.question: 哪个商品子类的利润率(总利润除以总销售额)最低?
records.chart_reading: 17 项中最高是 Phones(75,119.47),其次 Copiers(52,315.19),最低 Supplies(-89.85)。按 total_sales 计,最高是 Phones(417,939.31)。其中有 1 项为负值,如实画出。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sales), 2) AS total_sales,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.profit) / SUM(oi.sales), 4) AS profit_margin,
       COUNT(*) AS item_rows
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE oi.sales IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.sub_category
ORDER BY profit_margin ASC

records.question: 所有明细的销售额中位数是多少?
records.sql:
WITH v AS (
  SELECT sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sales) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS n
  FROM order_items WHERE sales IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(sales) AS median_sales
FROM v
WHERE rn IN ((n+1)/2, (n+2)/2)

records.question: 平均利润为负的商品子类有哪些?列出子类和平均利润。

SELECT p.sub_category, COUNT(*) AS item_rows, ROUND(AVG(oi.profit), 2) AS avg_profit
FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING AVG(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY avg_profit

records.question: 2014 年总利润为负(亏损)的商品子类,按亏损金额从小到大列出子类和总利润。
records.sql:
SELECT p.sub_category AS sub_category, ROUND(SUM(oi.profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.order_date >= '2014-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2015-01-01'
GROUP BY p.sub_category
HAVING SUM(oi.profit) < 0
ORDER BY total_profit ASC
